name: l3m-ragit
description: Current codebase context for GitHub Copilot through codebase-memory-mcp.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build

l3mRagit.enabled.description: Index saved changes in this workspace folder.

l3mRagit.backendPath.description: Executable path on the workspace host. Install codebase-memory-mcp separately.

l3mRagit.debounceMs.description: Combine nearby saved-file changes before indexing.

l3mRagit.indexMode.description: Upstream indexing mode. Full includes the broadest discovery.

l3mRagit.backendTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for one backend operation.

l3mRagit.contextTokens.description: Target retrieved-context budget. Chat also checks the selected model's actual token count.

l3mRagit.nativeMcp.description: Also expose upstream MCP tools directly. These bypass Ragit's freshness checks.

chatParticipants.name: ragit
chatParticipants.description: Ask about your code with freshly retrieved repository context.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show indexing state without calling a model

languageModelTools.name: l3m_ragit_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the current workspace and retrieve relevant source after pending saved-file updates finish.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve current repository context for a coding task. Use before changing unfamiliar code or after important saved edits. Waits for pending indexing; returns source snippets and relationships, not the whole repository. Specify workspace by folder name or absolute root in multi-root workspaces. Does not include unsaved buffers.

languageModelTools.name: l3m_ragit_symbol
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read an indexed symbol and its neighbors after refreshing saved changes.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read source for a qualified symbol name returned by ragit context or graph search. Includes neighbors. Specify workspace for multi-root workspaces. Waits for pending saved-file indexing.

languageModelTools.name: l3m_ragit_status
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show enabled workspaces and indexing state.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check whether Ragit has pending saved changes, an index error, or a completed index for each workspace. Does not imply unsaved buffers are indexed.
